label: copy phase of 9-token sequences: echoed-back early token b (also n/z/j) around recall step 2
explanation: Very sparse, weak unit (max over-threshold 0.007). Fires only in the copy phase, never during original input or on <DEL>. 96% of mass is in L=9 sequences (the rest L=8), and all of it is at recall_idx 1-3 (t=10-12), mostly recall_idx 2, where the input is the fed-back original token 1. It is strongly token-selective on that input: b holds about 65% of mass, and n, z and j hold most of the rest. The top activations are all b at original position 1 being echoed at t=11. It does not fire for other input tokens, for later copy steps, or in shorter sequences. Precision is poor: most L=9 sequences with b at position 1 stay inactive, and the extra factor that decides this was not found (out_tok gives a weak signal). Broader predicate: L=9, recall_idx in {1,2}, in_tok in {b,n,z,j} gets dev mass recall 0.90 but precision 0.07. The recorded predicate (b, recall_idx 2, L=9) gets the best dev F1, 0.34.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+3.66), phase=2 & in_tok=j (+3.53), phase=2 & in_tok=n (+3.47), phase=2 & in_tok=b (+2.50), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+2.34), in_tok=b (+2.16).
